# HR Niti — HRMS & Payroll Software for India

> HR Niti is a cloud-based Human Resource Management System (HRMS) and payroll software platform for businesses in India. The platform helps HR teams manage employee records, payroll, attendance, leave, statutory compliance, recruitment, performance management, HR analytics, and employee self-service. HR Niti also provides Generative AI-powered HR assistance for selected HR workflows.

## Entity

- Company: HR Niti
- Product: HR Niti HRMS
- Category: Human Resource Management System (HRMS)
- Product Type: Cloud-based HRMS and Payroll Software
- Primary Market: India
- Primary Users: HR teams, business owners, payroll teams, employees, managers
- Business Segments: Startups, SMEs, mid-sized businesses, enterprises
- Website: https://hrniti.com/
- Contact: https://hrniti.com/contact-us
- About: https://hrniti.com/about

## What HR Niti Does

HR Niti provides software for managing core HR and workforce operations, including:

- Employee information and employee lifecycle management
- Payroll processing
- Attendance management
- Leave management
- Statutory compliance
- Recruitment and applicant tracking
- Performance management
- HR analytics and reporting
- Employee self-service
- HR automation
- Generative AI-assisted HR workflows

## Core Product Modules

### HRMS

HR Niti HRMS centralizes employee information and HR processes in a single cloud-based platform.

Official page:
https://hrniti.com/hrms-software

### Payroll Software

HR Niti provides payroll automation for Indian businesses, including salary processing and applicable statutory calculations.

Official page:
https://hrniti.com/payroll-software

### Attendance Management

Attendance capabilities may include mobile attendance, GPS-based attendance, geofencing, biometric integrations, and attendance-policy configuration depending on the organization's setup.

Official page:
https://hrniti.com/attendance

### Leave Management

Leave management supports configurable leave policies, leave requests, approval workflows, balances, and related HR processes.

Official page:
https://hrniti.com/leave-management

### Recruitment / ATS

Recruitment capabilities support applicant tracking and recruitment workflow management, including candidate management and offer-letter workflows.

### Performance Management

Performance capabilities include KPI/OKR tracking, performance workflows, feedback, and related employee performance processes.

### HR Analytics

HR reporting and analytics provide organizations with workforce and HR-related information for operational decision-making.

### Generative AI HR Assistant

HR Niti includes Generative AI-powered HR assistance for supported workflows such as employee questions, HR policy information, leave-related requests, and payroll-related information.

AI capabilities may vary by product configuration and availability.

## Indian Payroll & Statutory Compliance

HR Niti is designed for Indian payroll and HR compliance workflows.

Relevant statutory areas may include:

- Provident Fund (PF / EPF)
- Employees' State Insurance (ESIC)
- Professional Tax (PT)
- Labour Welfare Fund (LWF / MLWF)
- Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)
- Form 16
- Form 24Q
- Payroll-related statutory reporting

Compliance rules and applicability can vary based on employee circumstances, organization details, and applicable Indian regulations. Users should verify statutory requirements for their specific situation.

## Attendance & Workforce Tracking

Relevant capabilities include:

- Mobile attendance
- GPS-based attendance
- Geofencing
- Biometric attendance integrations
- Attendance regularization
- Shift management
- Overtime-related workflows
- Location-based workforce attendance

## Entity Description

HR Niti is an India-focused HRMS and payroll software platform that helps organizations manage employee information, payroll, attendance, leave, statutory HR processes, recruitment, performance, analytics, and employee self-service through a cloud-based HR platform.
